summary__en: Steal an Egg's Halloween event adds the Halloween Dimension, an event zone with its own eggs and pets, including the Divine Voidseer Pumpkin and the Secret Grave Cerberus. Part 1 (the Halloween Dimension) ran from 17 Oct 2026 15:00 UTC to 24 Oct 2026 14:00 UTC on the Roblox event page. Part 2 is listed from 24 Oct 2026 15:00 UTC to 25 Oct 2026 16:34 UTC. The Enchanted Forest zone is in our lists too. Event pets are marked limited.
source_note: Publish time from the Roblox games API (our update tracker); what the event adds is from the community wiki; release date 17 Oct 2026 from the Roblox event page (Ali, 2026-10-24); Part 1 and Part 2 times from the Roblox virtual-events API (2026-10-24)

summary__en: Part 2 of Steal an Egg's Halloween event started on 24 Oct 2026 at 15:00 UTC and runs until 25 Oct 2026 at 16:34 UTC on the Roblox event page. The preview says a sealed portal has appeared beyond the gates of the Abandoned Manor. The game published a new version at 14:28 UTC. The new pets and eggs are not listed by the community wiki yet; we add them when they are.
source_note: Event window and preview from the Roblox virtual-events API; publish time from the Roblox games API (our update tracker)
